method.scope: Preflight 15 byline-disjoint, article-level CC BY 4.0 eLife articles with pinned final JATS and normalized 12-token disjointness against eleven retained packets. One plain-text original and one exact ordinary same-work substitution per source. Native bibliography references omitted during prose extraction.
method.generation: Three attempts with each of two pinned Apache-2.0 instruction model families. Keep the first completed single-sentence rewrite satisfying the retained length, copy and unchanged-segmentation rules. Record all attempted outputs. Selection uses no classifier responses.
method.reference: First six source-ordered native primary contexts at raw .50. The overlap read covers each complete measured context.
method.exact: Use the previously published independent sentence score and cutoff without any fit. Compare the unique highest eligible isolated sentence to the cutoff by strict excess. Require an interior focus of 12–65 lexical words and native immediate neighbors of 8–80 words each. The classifier sees only the focus. All measured inputs require one complete tokenizer window.
method.locations: A useful location covers at least half the known edited nonwhitespace characters and reaches .30 intersection over union. Record exact offsets, wrong-only marks, misses and work-level false alarms. Union preserves the incumbent marks.
method.advance: Require six admitted rewrites per family, all admitted known targets measured, at least two added held work groups across both generator families, and at most one additional ordinary work group compared with the incumbent. A pass supports bounded further development, with no change to file-level confidence.
